raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Amiya, all the rescue squads have reached Rhodes Island.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Amiya, all the rescue squads have reached Rhodes Island.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We've extracted all the recon squads except for Meteorite's.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   No Operators were lost on this mission, but...

content: No Operators were lost on this mission, but...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Everyone suffered frostbite with varying degrees of severity.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   You must take note of this.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You must take note of this.

speaker: Amiya
content: ...Frostbite?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   All our recon squads observed a special group of Reunion troops wandering around the city.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: All our recon squads observed a special group of Reunion troops wandering around the city.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Unlike the reckless Reunion soldiers we're used to fighting, these members had a special way of fighting.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Unlike the reckless Reunion soldiers we're used to fighting, these members had a special way of fighting.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Be cautious.

speaker: Amiya
content: I.... I understand.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Dr. {@nickname}, am I clear?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Very well then.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   I also have some things to do.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I also have some things to do.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]   Amiya, even if Dr. {@nickname} is very helpful, you can't rely too much on a single person.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Amiya, even if Dr. {@nickname} is very helpful, you can't rely too much on a single person.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Also, mind the rings.

speaker: Amiya
content: I know.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   Dr. Kal'tsit actually worries about you a lot.
speaker: Amiya
content: Dr. Kal'tsit actually worries about you a lot.

speaker: Amiya
content: Before we realized it...

raw: [name="Amiya"]   Dangerous beasts have bared their fangs.

content: Dangerous beasts have bared their fangs.

content: Projekt Red, do you copy?
